title: Privacy Policy
metaDescription: FileFolks processes all files locally in your browser. No data is ever uploaded or stored.
s1Heading: Your files never leave your browser
s1Body: Every tool on FileFolks runs entirely in your browser using WebAssembly and native browser APIs. No file data, names, contents, or metadata is ever sent to a server. Open your browser's Network tab while using any tool and you will see no upload requests.
s2Body: Nothing. FileFolks sets no cookies, loads no analytics or tracking scripts, and requires no account. We do not log or store anything about you or your files.
s3Body: Page fonts are self-hosted at build time. No requests are made to Google Fonts or any external provider.
s4Body: Material changes will be reflected by an updated date at the top of this page.
